mapper.sql: w.warning_id, w.store_id, w.book_id, w.isbn, w.title, w.warning_type, w.current_qty, w.safety_qty, w.gap_qty, w.avg_sale_30d, w.sale_days_30d, w.suggest_qty, w.last_sale_time, w.handle_status, w.handle_by, w.handle_time, w.handle_remark, w.create_time, w.update_time
mapper.select: select from biz_stock_warning w where w.handle_status = 1

select b.book_id as bookId, b.isbn as isbn, b.title as title, b.status as bookStatus, ifnull(s.available_qty, 0) as availableQty, ifnull(s.total_qty, 0) as totalQty, ifnull(s.safety_qty, 0) as safetyQtyInDb, ifnull(f.sale_qty_30d, 0) as saleQty30d, f.last_sale_time as lastSaleTime, f.first_flow_time as firstFlowTime, e.textbook_end_time as textbookEndTime from biz_book b left join ( select book_id, sum(qty_available) as available_qty, sum(qty_available + qty_locked + qty_borrowed + qty_damaged) as total_qty, max(safety_qty) as safety_qty from biz_stock group by book_id ) s on s.book_id = b.book_id left join ( select book_id, sum(case when biz_type = 2 and create_time >= #{since} then -qty_change else 0 end) as sale_qty_30d, max(case when biz_type = 2 then create_time end) as last_sale_time, min(create_time) as first_flow_time from biz_stock_flow group by book_id ) f on f.book_id = b.book_id left join ( select i.book_id, min(l.end_time) as textbook_end_time from biz_textbook_list_item i join biz_textbook_list l on l.list_id = i.list_id where l.status = 2 and l.end_time is not null and l.end_time >= #{nowTime} group by i.book_id ) e on e.book_id = b.book_id where b.del_flag = '0' order by b.book_id
